segments.name: Capital Markets
products: real estate-related investment banking and advisory services
segments.description: Originates, brokers and sells commercial real estate loans and provides property sales, appraisal and investment banking services to property owners and investors.
segments.evidence: CM provides a comprehensive range of commercial real estate finance products to our customers, including Agency lending, debt brokerage, property sales, appraisal and valuation services, and real estate-related investment banking and advisory services, including housing market research.

segments.name: Servicing & Asset Management
products: servicing and asset-managing the portfolio of loans
segments.description: Services and asset-manages loans originated for the Agencies and brokers, and manages third-party capital invested in commercial real estate for investors.
segments.evidence: SAM earns revenue mainly through fees for servicing and asset-managing the loans in the Company's servicing portfolio and asset management fees for managing third-party capital.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.description: Holds the company's treasury operations and other corporate-level activities, including support functions, rather than client-facing lending or servicing work.
segments.evidence: The Corporate segment consists primarily of the Company's treasury operations and other corporate-level activities.

revenueModel.text: Clients and investors pay origination, debt brokerage, property sales, appraisal and servicing fees, plus asset management fees and research subscription fees.
revenueModel.evidence: SAM earns revenue mainly through fees for servicing and asset-managing the loans in the Company's servicing portfolio and asset management fees for managing third-party capital.
